basic_info.description: Offered for the first time in 68 years, this rare and exceptional property features two stunning Victorian homes on one oversized lot in the heart of Duboce Triangle. In the same family since 1951 and passed to the current owners in 1988, this is truly a unique opportunity.    The rear home, a pre-1906 Victorian (approx. 1,544 sq ft), has been the owner's residence for 37 years. It includes 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, a large living room, spacious kitchen, two bonus rooms, and views of Downtown SF and and Mt. Diablo. Additional highlights include a basement/storage space (approx. 170 sq ft), laundry area, and two private sundecks.    At the front of the lot sits a second Victorian building (approx. 1,789 sq ft) comprised of two fully renovated 2-bed, 1.5-bath units. Upgraded recently with Viking ranges, stainless appliances, in-unit laundry, modern baths, central heat, and private sun porches overlooking a shared courtyard.    Ideal for owner-users, multi-generational living, or investors, this property is a rare blend of character, flexibility, and historic charm.
